gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-phoenician: Expose packs its lowercase tight against the capitals, with hardly a pause. Noto Sans Phoenician loosens things up, with generous lowercase height and wide-mouthed s curves that let paragraphs unroll without strain.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Striking from the first glance, Expose crams its lowercase against the capitals and moves at a compressed, barely breathing pace. Noto Sans Samaritan brings hefty lowercase with daylight inside every curve.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Expose is all tension, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals and its cadence compressed. Noto Sans Tagbanwa relaxes into open curves and lowercase that fills most of the height.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Expose runs compressed, with capitals and lowercase standing almost shoulder to shoulder. Noto Sans Tai Le tapers its ink strokes out before they touch, leaving Expose to grab attention while it carries the text.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Noto Sans Tai Viet keeps its ascenders short and its x-height tall. Terminals pull back from each curve's closing point, so text flows smoothly beneath Expose, whose compressed, striking caps and lowercase nearly meet.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC gives tall a, s and e large open counters, with curves that flare outward instead of curling in. Expose, tight and striking, tops it with compressed lines.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Tight meets plump: Expose squeezes its caps and lowercase close, while Noto Sans Tifinagh swells into rounded, inviting bowls. One squeezes, the other inflates; each makes the other look sharper.
gen-fs-expose-gf-numans: Tight and sharp up top: Expose lets its lowercase nearly touch the capitals, with hardly a pause. Numans then spreads out, its plump lowercase and generously tracked lines giving long text room to move.
gen-fs-expose-gf-onest: Expose packs its lowercase tight against the capitals and moves with a compressed, striking cadence. Onest, with short ascenders above big bowls and a pen-like line of constant weight, loosens everything beneath it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-orienta: Orienta keeps its counters breathing like a hollow reed cut open, with barely any height difference between cases. Expose supplies the striking, compressed drama, and that tension is the whole point.
